test_title: PYST 8: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 24 March 2021 (Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following pairs of symbols will NOT be on the opposite faces when the given sheet is folded to form a cube?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a57d518b2861f382a03f0fac05e479848877767e899481962dcf94e1def005e.png]
solution:
From diagram we see that,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b84464881d195f59f925c9dcba2247f5093dde13bdadb6083c12985c21c197cf.png] 

@ is opposite of &

$ is opposite of %

# is opposite of +

Hence, % and @ are not opposite faces.
